jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Business Analyst - Utilities | FSM / ERP Implementations (Multiple positions available)  
**Company:** Celerity Consulting Group  
**Location**: Remote (work from home eligible) with the ability to travel for client meetings and workshops  
**Salary:** $100,000 - $120,000 annually DOE  
  
**Company Overview:** Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in the utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients. Our background and expertise also enable us to implement enterprise systems & solutions, driving digital transformation and operational excellence for our clients.  
  
**Position Overview:** We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with over 8 years of experience in implementing projects for enterprise systems (ERPs, CRMs, FSM, etc.) and a strong background in the utilities/energy/telecom industries. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in analyzing client business processes, identifying requirements, and implementing solutions to enhance operational efficiency.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Requirements Gathering and Analysis:**

* Engage with clients to understand and document their business processes, needs, and objectives related to field service operations.
* Analyze and translate business requirements into functional specifications for enterprise solutions.
* Conduct gap analyses to identify areas where current systems fall short of client needs.

**Solution Design and Implementation:**

* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that align with client requirements and industry best practices.
* Assist in configuring and customizing tools to meet specific client needs.
* Develop and execute test plans to ensure solutions meet specified requirements and quality standards.

**Stakeholder Communication and Management:**

* Serve as a liaison between clients, project managers, and technical teams to ensure clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements, present solutions, and obtain stakeholder buy-in.
* Prepare and deliver presentations and reports to clients and internal stakeholders.

**Process Improvement and Optimization:**

* Identify opportunities to enhance client business processes through the effective use of FSM solutions.
* Recommend best practices and innovative solutions to improve field service operations and efficiency.
* Monitor solution performance and suggest enhancements based on data analysis and client feedback.

**Testing**

* Hands on experience writing detailed user stories, test cases and executing tests. Should have an eye for details and be familiar with arduous test cases.
* Experience logging, tracking, prioritizing and validating defects.
* Experience guiding new users through individual and collaborative UAT sessions.
* Should be familiar with navigating difficult conversations with users when bugs are uncovered or business needs are deprioritized for the scope of the project.

**Training and Support:**

* Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for clients to ensure successful adoption of enterprise solutions.
* Provide ongoing support to clients’ post-implementation to address issues and optimize solution usage

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required.
* Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a focus on Enterprise Field Service Management and mobile workforce solutions.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, and solution implementation.
* Hands-on experience with SQL to access, retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data.
* Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, MS SharePoint, Process design tools (Vizio, Signavio, etc.) and similar PMO tools.
* Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and field service management (REQUIRED)
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and propose effective solutions.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with business integration requirements across technology stack (ERP, CRM, CIS, BI, Datawarehouse, etc.)
* Ability to travel to client sites (domestic and(or) international) as required and defined per project requirements.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Consulting background with experience in client-facing roles and managing stakeholder relationships.
* Proficiency in using FSM software platforms a plus.
* Familiarity with GIS integration and mobile workforce management solutions.
* Knowledge of emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, and Machine Learning as they apply to Field Service Management.
* Professional certifications related to Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP) or Project Management (e.g., PMP).

The salary range for this position is provided in good faith and is subject to variation based on geographic location, candidate experience, and market conditions. Final compensation will be determined after a comprehensive evaluation of the candidate’s qualifications and alignment with the role.

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws—including but not limited to those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and other jurisdictions—we disclose salary ranges to promote equity and transparency. **Description**

Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives. Norstella unites market-leading brands - Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients:

* Accelerate the drug development cycle
* Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market
* Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
* Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
* Identify and address barriers to therapies

Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella's investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.

This individual will report to the VP of Client Delivery, working closely with other members of the Marketing and Client Delivery team and collaborating with various internal teams across Skipta to ensure flawless execution of client campaigns within contractually obligated timelines.

* Monitoring campaign KPI’s on a daily basis to ensure monthly engagement goals are met
* Experience creating, testing, and deploying marketing campaigns in Salesforce automation platform
* QA reviewing and testing client-sponsored email campaigns to ensure seamless execution
* Providing status updates, tracking, and engagement reports to internal teams for client-sponsored multi-channel promotional programs
* Planning and communicating campaign specific programmatic media requirements
* Organizing programs and activities in accordance with the mission and goals of the organization
* Implementing, managing, and optimizing campaigns to ensure engagement goals are achieved
* Supporting Marketing & Client Delivery Team by helping with special requests and projects as needed

### **Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of digital marketing, business analytics, and/or project management experience
* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree, Marketing or Communications concentration preferred
* Experience in Healthcare/pharmaceuticals is a plus
* Experience with Marketing Automation and Analytics tools, specifically Salesforce, Airtable, and Tableau
* Working knowledge of programmatic media (E.g., planning, guiding campaign business specifications, and reporting)
* Experience with CSS and HTML coding, experience with email-specific coding a plus
* Exceptional written and verbal communications skills, including email copywriting expertise
* Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation.Ability to work autonomously in a remote environment

jobs.description:

Collaborates with cross-functional teams, manages risks and progress, and ensures alignment with the University’s priorities and stakeholder expectations.

This position will support the new Student Information System (SIS)/Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Program in IT Development.

2. Establish the SIS/ERP program's change management framework.

3. Create and implement stakeholder engagement plan.

4. Establish and manage governance and accountability for decision making and committee establishment.

8. Build a communication strategy and calendar in collaboration with communications team across the university.

9. Define readiness KPIs and scorecard criteria. Measure participation and engagement.

* Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Positive, collaborative, and able to remain calm and effective under pressure.

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills; able to assess situations, evaluate information, and solve both routine and complex problems using sound judgment.

Ability to communicate effectively in meetings and collaborative settings, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Lead process modernization efforts by identifying opportunities for automation, AI-enabled productivity improvements, and workflow optimization that enhance efficiency and user experience

-----------------

* Demonstrated experience working across multi-disciplinary workstreams (e.g., software/solutions implementation and workforce training/enablement).
* Exceptional risk and issue management capabilities with a proactive approach to escalation and resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to clearly bridge business requirements and technical execution.
* Proven ability to move with careful urgency, take proactive initiative, and operate resourcefully in environments with ambiguous requirements.

---------------

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

jobs.title: D365 Project Manager, Managed Services
jobs.description:
**Location** Virtual, home based office with travel

**Description**

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

  

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

* MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments.
* New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment.
* A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility.

  

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

  

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

  

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

### **Responsibilities**

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

**Core project management, all work streams**
---------------------------------------------

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

* Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them.
* Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work.
* Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans.
* Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation.
* Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones.
* Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards.
* Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry.

**MgS live support clients**
----------------------------

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

* Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability.
* Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure.
* Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person.
* Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan.
* Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews.
* Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early.
* Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes.
* Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals.
* Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction.
* Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred.

**New functionality and enhancement delivery**
----------------------------------------------

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

* Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources.
* Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve.
* Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins.
* Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support

jobs.description:
**Senior Business Intelligence Analyst**

**Reports to:** Director of Data Strategy & Analytics

**Direct reports:** None

**Job Location:** US, Remote. Must work and reside within the US for this position.

**Job Overview:**

Lexia's data is central to how we grow and how we demonstrate impact. We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to turn that data into timely, actionable reporting and analysis that shape outcomes across our go-to-market teams.

Reporting to the Director of Data Strategy & Analytics, the Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will be a hands-on analytics partner to Customer Success, Marketing, and Sales. Working with the data models built by our Analytics Engineering team, you will develop the dashboards, KPIs, analyses and AI agents that help these teams understand performance, spot opportunities, and act on them.

This role sits at the intersection of the business and our data. You will translate stakeholder questions into clear analytical approaches, communicate what the data shows and what to do about it, and help build the self-service and AI-enabled tools that let more of Lexia get answers directly.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Reporting & Dashboard Development**
  + Build, maintain, and continuously improve Tableau dashboards and reports that give Customer Success, Marketing, and Sales executives clear visibility into pipeline, bookings, renewals, product usage, campaign performance, and other key business metrics.
  + Develop and maintain meaningful, well-defined KPIs, ensuring metrics are consistent across reports and aligned with agreed-upon business definitions.
  + Deliver recurring business performance reporting and forecasting that executives can rely on for planning and operational conclusions.

* **Business Analysis & Insights**
  + Conduct in-depth analyses of revenue, customer, and operational data to answer key business questions, such as campaign attribution, account scoring, pipeline health, and retention/churn drivers.
  + Go beyond reporting what happened to explain why, and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations through strong data storytelling.
  + Handle ad hoc and confidential analysis requests with accuracy, sound judgment, and appropriate care for sensitive data.

* **Data Models & Collaboration with Analytics Engineering**
  + Use the data warehouse marts and Tableau Cloud data sources provided by Analytics Engineering as the foundation for reporting and analysis, writing SQL to explore, validate, and combine data as needed.
  + Translate stakeholder needs into clear data requirements and metric definitions, and partner with Analytics Engineering to request new or enhanced data models when gaps arise.
  + Identify and escalate data quality issues, and help establish consistent data and reporting standards that increase confidence in our numbers.

* **Stakeholder Partnership**
  + Serve as a day-to-day analytics partner to Customer Success, Marketing, and Sales, building proven working relationships and a deep understanding of each team's goals, processes, and data.
  + Scope requests with stakeholders, set clear expectations on timelines, and help prioritize work in partnership with the Director of Data Strategy & Analytics.

* **Self-Service & AI-Enabled Analytics**
  + Contribute to the design and rollout of self-service dashboards, AI agents, and conversational analytics tools that enable non-technical staff to answer questions of our data directly.
  + Support stakeholder enablement through documentation, training, and office hours, and follow data and AI governance policies to ensure analytics tools and data are used appropriately.
  + Look for opportunities to automate recurring work and apply new tools and best practices that improve scale, efficiency, and quality.

**Job Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, data science, analytics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in an analytical role, with a preference for experience supporting sales, marketing, customer success, or business operations.
* Advanced proficiency in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool) and exceptional SQL skills for querying and validating data in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Redshift).
* Experience working with curated data models built by data or analytics engineering teams; familiarity with Dbt is a plus.
* Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM, and with Excel.
* Demonstrated experience producing business-driven dashboards and reports and developing meaningful KPIs.
* Experience with go-to-market analyses such as campaign attribution, account scoring, pipeline analysis, or retention/churn analysis; familiarity with Python or R for statistical analysis is a plus.
* Interest in or experience with AI-assisted analytics tools, such as AI agents, natural language query interfaces, or LLM-driven analytics.
* Experience within a SaaS B2B or B2G organization preferred.
* Curiosity and a passion for asking “why?” to get to the root of an issue, paired with effective deductive and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Excellent attention to detail, excellent follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment.

To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit https://www.lexialearning.com/.

**Remote First Work Environment**

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.

jobs.description:

Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

You'll join CoreWeave's Global Security & Resilience organization to build and drive the security program supporting our rapidly expanding international footprint — including offices we operate directly and locations where we support our data center teams. You'll work closely with executive protection, the GSOC, External Affairs, and cross-functional business leaders to protect our people and operations as CoreWeave scales globally.

The Staff Security Program Manager, International Security will own and drive CoreWeave's international security program, with responsibility for global travel security, international office and site protection, global security partnerships and outreach, and support for executive protection and event security as needed. You'll partner closely with CoreWeave's Senior Manager, Corporate Security, who leads the domestic program, to coordinate standards, incident response, and shared protective operations.

This individual contributor role combines enterprise program ownership with hands-on operational execution. You'll design and stand up a world-class travel security program — pre-travel risk assessments, traveler tracking and duty-of-care protocols, in-country support, and emergency response for employees traveling or working abroad. You'll also establish security standards for CoreWeave's growing international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, in partnership with Facilities, Data Center Operations, and local leadership.

A significant part of this role is external-facing: building and sustaining global partnerships with law enforcement, intelligence services, diplomatic security, industry peers, and trusted local security providers in the countries where CoreWeave operates. You'll also provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and event security as needed — including advances, logistics coordination, and on-the-ground protective coverage — both domestically and internationally.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, cultural fluency, and sound judgment operating in ambiguous, fast-moving international environments. You must be comfortable building programs from the ground up, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, working through a network of internal teams, contractors, and in-country partners, and delivering results with limited on-the-ground infrastructure. This role has no direct reports.

**About the role:**
-------------------

* Design, build, and own CoreWeave's global travel security program, including pre-travel risk assessments, country risk ratings, traveler tracking, duty-of-care protocols, and coordination of 24/7 emergency response and evacuation support for employees traveling or working abroad.
* Develop and maintain security standards, governance, and risk assessments for CoreWeave's international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, balancing consistent global controls with local risk, culture, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and sustain global partnerships and outreach with foreign law enforcement, intelligence, diplomatic security, and industry security counterparts, as well as trusted in-country guard force, investigative, and protective service providers.
* Serve as CoreWeave's primary international security point of contact for new-market entry and international office openings, conducting site and country risk assessments and coordinating security coverage ahead of business expansion.
* Drive program execution across internal teams, regional security partners, and contracted providers, establishing clear requirements, coordinating deliverables, and evaluating provider performance.
* Personally plan and provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and high-profile event security as needed, including advances, route and venue assessments, logistics coordination, and on-site protective coverage domestically and abroad.
* Translate threat, political, and protective intelligence into practical guidance for travelers, international offices, and business leaders, including country and regional travel advisories.
* Coordinate with the GSOC, the domestic Corporate Security team, and internal response teams to ensure seamless monitoring, escalation, and incident management for international employees, offices, and events.

As one of the largest employers in the State of New Jersey, Rutgers University is committed not only to the students and the State that we serve, but also to the faculty and staff who work on our campuses.

For two consecutive years, Rutgers is ranked on Forbes’ list of America’s Best Large Employers. Rutgers holds #64 of 500 employers and is the #1 New Jersey employer on the publication’s 2023 list. Rutgers’ commitment to its employees includes maintaining and fostering a safe, diverse, and respectful workplace environment, creating employment opportunities for our nation’s military veterans, and ensuring accessibility and accommodation for individuals with disabilities.

  

**Posting Summary**

Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey, is seeking a Research Analyst to join the Center for Pharmacoepidemiology and Treatment Science (PETS) within the Rutgers Institute for Health, Health Care Policy and Aging Research. Established in 2017, PETS facilitates and conducts innovative, multidisciplinary research focused on the use and outcomes of therapeutics and diagnostics in large populations. Its mission is to advance pharmacoepidemiology and related fields through world-class research and high-quality training. PETS brings together faculty and collaborators from Rutgers and external academic, industry, and regulatory organizations with expertise spanning epidemiology, biostatistics, biomedical informatics, clinical medicine, economics, and the social sciences.

The Research Analyst will provide data-analytic support for a large portfolio of population health research and work closely with investigators and senior staff to implement statistical programming and analyses using SAS and other analytical software. The incumbent will develop and maintain sophisticated programs to analyze large, sensitive healthcare administrative databases and population-based survey data. Research activities will involve highly complex “big data” resources, including Medicare, Medicaid, and other healthcare datasets containing hundreds of millions of records, with the goal of generating evidence to inform therapeutic decision-making and health policy.

* Prepares, manages, and documents large healthcare claims, electronic health record, survey, and other research datasets.
* Conducts routine and advanced statistical programming and analyses using SAS and other analytic software.
* Contributes to cohort construction, variable creation, data quality assessment, and analytic dataset development.
* Performs data validation and quality control activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability of research data.
* Supports data linkage and integration activities across multiple complex data sources.
* Develops tables, figures, visualizations, and analytic summaries for manuscripts, presentations, grant applications, and reports.
* Collaborates with investigators and research staff to interpret findings and support study objectives.
* Maintains organized code, datasets, and documentation to support reproducibility and compliance requirements.
* Contributes to the testing and implementation of analytic tools, databases, and research infrastructure.
* Assists with preparation of manuscripts, progress reports, grant materials, and other scientific deliverables.
* Supports compliance with IRB requirements, Data Use Agreements, and applicable privacy and security regulations.
* Participates in research dissemination activities, including presentations, publications, and conference submissions.
* Stays current with developments in statistical programming, healthcare data resources, and research methods.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Scientific Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
DRT Strategies delivers expert management consulting and information technology (IT) solutions to large federal agencies, state and local government and commercial clients in health care, technology, and financial services industries.  
  
The three letters of our name, DRT, stand for Driving Resolution Together, which is the core philosophy on which the company was founded. That is, we collaborate with our clients to solve their most pressing challenges - together.  
  
We are problem solvers dedicated to your success, combining Fortune 500 experience with small business responsiveness. We have established a reputation with our clients as a forward-thinking consulting firm with demonstrated success in implementing solutions that lead to meaningful results. Our world-class consultants unite people to work collaboratively to achieve project goals and make vision a reality.  
  
**Project Description:**  
The position is in the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the Office of the Commissioner (OC), Office of the Chief Scientist (OCS), Office of Regulatory and Emerging Science (ORES). The FDA is a Federal scientific agency with the legislated responsibility to protect and promote the public health of the Nation's consumers. ORES advances key regulatory science priorities, including innovative technologies, advanced manufacturing, and supply chain resilience, to strengthen FDA's ability to evaluate the safety, effectiveness, and quality of FDA-regulated products.  
  
ORES supports, funds, and conducts regulatory science research through both intramural and extramural programs. Intramural efforts are carried out by FDA scientists and staff working within FDA to develop and apply innovative tools, methods, and approaches that strengthen the agency's regulatory capabilities. Extramural efforts extend this work by funding and collaborating with academic institutions, research organizations, and other external partners to advance the broader regulatory science enterprise. Together, these complementary research programs enable ORES to identify and address emerging scientific challenges, inform evidence-based regulatory decision-making, and build the scientific foundation necessary to support FDA's mission.  
  
**Job Summary:**  
This position acts as the Project Manager for the Innovative Technologies Team in ORES, supporting initiatives that leverage advanced manufacturing to address critical supply chain vulnerabilities and advance regulatory science priorities. Under the direction of the Innovative Technologies Team Lead, the Project Manager applies their knowledge and professional skills to organize complex assignments that advance high-priority projects, manage operational functions of the Innovative Technologies Team, and support the team's broader mission and management functions.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and documentation. Manage strategic projects through the full life cycle using industry best practices.
* Monitor project status across assigned portfolio; identify and resolve risks, delays, and issues.
* Ensure project activities remain aligned with objectives and scope, coordinate deliverables and timelines.
* Coordinate evaluations of Innovative Technologies Team projects and procedures.
* Identify problem areas and best practices, recognize trends, and recommend program improvements.
* Meet with managers, stakeholders, and collaborators to define goals and objectives of high-visibility projects.
* Serve as point of contact for internal and external inquiries; draft and distribute meeting communications and program correspondence.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and summaries.
* Coordinate meetings and leadership discussions, including scheduling, agendas, materials, and logistics; support seminars, webinars, and other events.
* Track action items and deadlines; capture meeting minutes and prepare technical and administrative reports. Represent the Innovative Technologies Team on assigned groups.
* Recommend integration of SMEs and coordinate with technical personnel as needed; prepare draft documents.
* Maintain project trackers, calendars, stakeholder lists, shared documents, SOPs, and program resources.
* Support development of processes, workflows, and templates; maintain program knowledge to support continuity of operations.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to support project goals and deliverables.

**Required Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience required.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as continuous manufacturing, 3D printing, or other innovative production methods.
* Knowledge of advanced manufacturing's role in supply chain resilience, drug shortages, or regulatory science.
* Knowledge of FDA regulatory science priorities, frameworks, or programs; prior federal agency or government contracting experience a plus.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams or managing relationships with academic, research, or external partner organizations.
* Background in engineering preferred

**Education & Training:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
* Experience in supply chain and/or drug shortage framework.

**Work Authorization, Clearance Requirement, & Additional Information:**

* This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government Public Trust clearance. Due to contract requirements, candidates must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents (green card holders) to be eligible.
* No agencies, third parties, or Corp-to-Corp submissions.

**Salary Range:**

* $80,000 - $100,000
* Salary commensurate with experience.

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting-edge technologies to the battle-space of the future. The F-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems & Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to serve as a primary point of contact for the CODE organization and provide senior-level leadership and oversight of contractor activities.

The Task Lead will coordinate contractor personnel, facilitate Government and Contractor communications, and ensure program activities are effectively planned, executed, monitored, and documented.

This role has a strong IT leadership and cybersecurity focus, with responsibility for supporting enterprise security, risk management, compliance, cross-team coordination, and strategic IT operations.

Requirements:

* Provide overall management and oversight of contractor personnel and activities.
* Serve as a primary liaison between Government and Contractor leadership.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

Akima Data Management (ADM), an Akima company, is not just another federal IT contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At ADM, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders**, ADM provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers**, ADM delivers agile and innovative cloud and IT services and solutions that enable mission dominance.

**As an ADM employee**, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. Description:

Responsibilities:

* Be responsible for the coordination and delivery of overall requirements.

* Participate with the G-6 and other required personnel in identifying critical issues associated with improvement and management of the network.
* Assess risks and maintain strategies to mitigate or avoid them.

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program.

Our Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Policy Analyst (FMS Program Analyst), Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

In this role, you will:

* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105.65-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* The ability to provide onsite support at the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
  + OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105.38-MX.

**The Opportunity:**

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

  

As a Defense Critical Infrastructure All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You'll work with interagency teams to determine threats to DoD critical infrastructure, providing executive clients with threat briefings and mitigation opportunities. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. jobs.title: Security Analyst - Technical Security - Entry to Experienced Level (Maryland)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people, and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Security personnel oversee the development, installation, and maintenance of physical security systems. Security personnel help maintain integral elements of an overall security theory, posture, and infrastructure designed to efficiently deter, delay, detect and identify threats to NSA people, resources and facilities.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Federal employees - Excepted service**

Current federal employees whose agencies have their own hiring rules, pay scales and evaluation criteria.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

  

**Duties**
----------

Security and Counterintelligence is responsible for the protection of NSA/CSS information, people and facilities worldwide. In support of this mission, Technical Security Analysts provide security analysis, risk recommendations, and mitigations to decision makers and customers. They develop and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks. Technical Security Analysts prepare and maintain assessments and security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
  
  
Technical Security Analyst responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Applying principles, methods, and tools for assessing and mitigating threats/vulnerabilities
* Understanding commercial information technology marketplace, products, and services
* Assessing applicability of available tools to various situations
* Understanding the principal methods and techniques of gathering intelligence information
* Evaluating the scope and availability of intelligence analysis tools available at NSA
* Preparing and maintaining files, risk assessments, and technical security databases detailing the findings, recommendations, status, and results of assessment actions.
* Developing and monitoring implementation and effectiveness of countermeasures for mitigating security risks.
* Briefing customers and managers concerning technical security policy and procedures and specific cases.
* Applying technical security policy and regulations
* Using resources effectively and efficiently to arrange information in a useful manner
* Obtaining, evaluating, organizing, and maintaining information
* Disseminating information to appropriate internal and external parties
* Creating a product based on analysis of security and/or counterintelligence data
* Providing timely and accurate responses to requests for assistance, information, products or services
* Authoring routine and/or detailed documents such as assessments, reports, and memorandums
* Completing coursework and certifications through the US Air Force TEMPEST School and/or the Interagency Training Center.

  
The agency is currently hiring Security Analysts to specialize in:
  

* Technical Security

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* All applicants and employees are subject to random drug testing in accordance with Executive Order 12564.

### **Qualifications**

The qualifications listed are the minimum acceptable to be considered for the position.
  
  
Relevant experience must be in one or more of the following: signals analysis, intelligence analysis, financial analysis, research analysis, physical or personnel security, TEMPEST, radio frequency, counterintelligence, electrical/electronics, technical surveillance countermeasures, telecommunications, wireless security, network packet analysis, cybersecurity, acquisition management, risk assessment, or security and counterintelligence (CI) investigations, or construction/facilities.
  
  
ENTRY/DEVELOPMENTAL
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 4 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 2 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree and no experience.
  
  
FULL PERFORMANCE
  
Entry is with a high school diploma or GED plus 7 years of relevant experience, or an Associate's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience, or relevant military experience and 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree plus 3 years of relevant experience, or relevant security training plus 3 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree plus 1 year of relevant experience, or a Doctoral degree and no experience.

### **Education**

A degree in any field is acceptable. Military training must be at least 18 semester hours of training in security analysis.

### **Additional information**

Pay: Salary offers are based on candidates' education level and years of experience relevant to the position and also take into account information provided by the hiring manager/organization regarding the work level for the position.
  
  
Salary Range: $57,736 - $133,142 (Entry, Full Performance)
  
Salary range varies by location, work level, and relevant experience to the position.
  
  
Training will be provided based on the selectee's needs and experience.
  
  
Benefits: NSA offers a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
Work Schedule: This is a full-time position, Monday - Friday, with basic 8hr/day work requirement between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. (flexible).

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits
========

* Identifying and leveraging capabilities from across MITRE that enable the sponsor to measurably increase mission impact

Onsite

**Overview**

The Cyber Defense Investigations team is Microsoft's deep-dive investigative arm within Cyber Defense Operations (CDO). We investigate complex security incidents across Microsoft's cloud, identity, and supply chain environments, conduct root cause analysis, assess attacker activity, and drive actionable remediation and detection improvements.

As a **Security Analyst II,** you will lead investigations, craft quick detections, perform threat hunting, collaborate with engineering and response teams, and help improve Microsoft's ability to detect and respond to advanced threats.

Join Microsoft's CDI Escalations team and work at the forefront of cyber defense, investigating the most complex nation-state, supply chain, cloud, and identity-based attacks targeting Microsoft. Our team goes beyond traditional incident response, we combine deep investigations, threat hunting, intelligence operationalization, and cross-organizational collaboration to identify adversaries, drive platform-wide security improvements, and build defenses that prevent future attacks. You'll partner with leaders across MSTIC, GHOST, Detection Engineering, and service teams, leverage AI-powered investigation techniques, and directly influence Microsoft's security posture while solving some of the industry's hardest security challenges.

Starting February, 2026, Microsoft employees are expected to work from a designated Microsoft office at least three days a week if they live within 50 miles (U.S.) or 25 miles (non-U.S., country-specific) of that location. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Investigate complex security incidents involving cloud, identity, endpoint, and supply chain compromises.
* Ability to author detection at rapid speed.
* Conduct root cause analysis, impact assessment, and scope determination.
* Perform proactive threat hunting using Kusto (KQL), Defender, Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft telemetry sources.
* Partner with Detection Engineering, MSTIC, Service Teams, and Incident Response teams to contain and remediate threats.
* Develop investigative queries, hunting content, playbooks, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
* Translate investigation findings into actionable security improvements, detections, and process enhancements.
* Produce clear technical and executive-ready investigation reports.
* Mentor peers and contribute to investigative best practices and knowledge sharing.

Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response
OR equivalent experience.

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

You will leverage OSINT and tradecraft to uncover emerging threats, and develop strategic products that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.

**Overview**

Partner Investments drives revenue growth for Microsoft by leading the decisions and governance for the multi-billion portfolio of commercial investments across our Global Channel Partner Sales organization (GCPS). In addition, the team provides the governance and end-to-end ownership for systems, tools, analytics and compliance for GCPS.

This team is looking for a talented **Senior Program Manager** to join. We are a group who strive to be highly collaborative and curious, focused on impact, and proactive problem solvers with a mindset to drive our business forward. We are obsessed with the execution, implementation, and performance of our partner investments and incentives portfolio, and we care deeply about the success of our partners and customers. We are analytical thinkers who value quality and appreciate creativity grounded with common sense. We work hard and have fun as well. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make an impact on a global scale as you influence the future of our incentive programs through deep, insightful analytics.

You will lead the end-to-end management of a partner investment program, driving operational excellence, partner success, and compliance with program guidelines. This includes monitoring performance, maintaining effective controls, investigating misuse, and coordinating corrective actions through resolution. You will translate program insights into actionable improvements and work closely with the program design lead to shape design decisions that support strategic objectives. Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will coordinate related projects and lead initiatives that strengthen program performance and deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Manage program scope and objectives: Define success metrics, monitor delivery, and align priorities, resources, and budgets with strategic goals.

* Translate program design into launch-ready requirements: Clarify business requirements, controls, and dependencies, partnering with engineering and operations to implement, test, and launch program capabilities.

* Monitor program performance and ROI: Track results against success metrics, identify optimization opportunities, and influence future program design using data, operational experience, and partner insights.

* Lead stakeholder engagement and executive reporting: Build strong internal and external relationships and deliver clear business reviews, risk analyses, and recommendations to senior leadership.

* Oversee vendor management: Manage vendor relationships, contract negotiations, delivery commitments, and performance to meet program needs and optimize costs.

* Own escalations and resolution: Serve as the program escalation owner, drive decisions within delegated authority, and coordinate cross-functional responses to resolve critical issues and minimize business impact.

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 4+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement

jobs.description:
**Description**

The Health & Services Sector at Leidos has an opening for a **Program Manager – Electronic Health Record (EHR) Deployment** to support a newly awarded EHR modernization program for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), supporting U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).

The Program Manager will have overall responsibility for successful program execution and will serve as a primary interface with the Government customer. This role will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for the planning, implementation, deployment, and sustainment of an enterprise Oracle Health EHR solution. The Program Manager will be accountable for technical, schedule, financial, contractual, staffing, quality, and performance objectives and will coordinate closely with Government stakeholders, Oracle Health, subcontractors, and Leidos technical and functional teams.

This is an opportunity to lead a complex, mission-critical health IT modernization effort that will improve the delivery of healthcare services across DHS.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead overall program execution and ensure contractual, technical, financial, schedule, quality, and performance objectives are achieved.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for Government leadership and maintain effective relationships with the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), program stakeholders, and mission partners.
* Lead the planning, design, implementation, deployment, and sustainment of the Oracle Health EHR solution across the customer environment.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams spanning program management, clinical and functional operations, systems engineering, infrastructure, integration, cybersecurity, testing, training, deployment, and sustainment.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, staffing plans, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and performance metrics.
* Monitor program execution, identify deviations from plan, and lead corrective actions to maintain successful delivery.
* Manage program resources, staffing, subcontractors, and Other Direct Costs (ODCs) within established contractual and financial parameters.
* Lead deployment readiness and implementation activities, including coordination of technical, operational, training, and end-user readiness.
* Establish and maintain program risk, quality, configuration, and change management processes.
* Provide clear and timely program status, recommendations, executive briefings, metrics, and decision support to Government and Leidos leadership.
* Coordinate with Oracle Health and other technology vendors and implementation partners to resolve issues and deliver integrated capabilities.
* Oversee Agile program execution and ensure effective coordination across project teams, product owners, Scrum teams, and other stakeholders.
* Provide oversight of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning-related program components, including coordination of governance and risk-management activities consistent with DHS, ICE, and CBP policies.
* Build and maintain a high-performing program team, including workforce planning, staff development, performance management, and effective allocation of resources.

**Purpose / Scope:**

The Cybersecurity Analyst will perform assessment and authorization (A&A) efforts under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) on behalf of a federal civilian agency as a contractor. The role will conduct cybersecurity analysis in preparation for A&A reviewing and validation of all associated cybersecurity documentation and technical controls.

The role will work within a team that conducts A&A activities. This individual will develop System Security Plans (SSP), Contingency Plans, Business Impact Analyses (BIA), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), Security Assessment Report (SARs), Security Assessment Plan (SAPs), and other RMF documentation.

This position covers all cybersecurity aspects including, but not limited to, identifying risks, validating the mitigation of plans of action, analyzing system designs, and assisting with A&A issues that may prevent a system from receiving authorization. It supports the implementation of RMF by developing documentation and updating policies, procedures, and processes as assigned.

The Cybersecurity Analyst will assess and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle. Contribute to the security planning, assessment, risk analysis, risk management, certification and awareness activities for system and networking operations. Create and review A&A Body of Evidence documentation, providing feedback on completeness and compliance of its content. Develop and execute Security Test Plan (STP) in close cooperation with team members. Manage and ensure Continuous Monitoring (CONMON) to maintain system authorization.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Identify key stakeholders in A&A efforts and ensure system documentation reflects current system security configurations to include hardware and software components, data flow, interconnections, and ports, protocols, and services, etc.
* Identify potential risks associated with system configurations and advise on mitigation strategies
* Participate in A&A status meetings and facilitate moving systems toward a successful A&A effort
* Assist to estimate Level of Effort (LOE) involved in performing A&A activities
* Assist customer program offices in interpreting and applying mitigation strategies
* Conduct thorough reviews of all vulnerabilities, architecture, and defense in depth strategies and report findings in POA&Ms document
* Document residual risks and provide the cybersecurity risk analysis and mitigation determination results
* Maintain cybersecurity policy and processes as assigned
* Able to analyze, interpret, and apply Federal cybersecurity guidance to customer needs
* Communicate the security posture of systems through designated reporting mechanism
* Collaborate with other team members in cybersecurity

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience in the following areas: Cybersecurity policy, procedures, and processes, including RMF and NIST 800-53 and A&A's
* Experience developing A&A documentation from scratch and performing assessments; RMF step 1 through 4
* Familiar with NIST publications, specifically RMF and NIST controls
* One or more of the following certifications preferred (Security+, CAP, CISSP, CISM, GSEC, GCIH, or GSLC)

* Familiar with dealing with defense-in-depth, and other information security and assurance principles and associated supporting technologies
* Hands on experience and detailed familiarity with the A&A processes

* Must be able to read, speak, write, and understand the English language

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BA/BS Degree

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst-2
jobs.description:
The Business Operations Analyst provides day-to-day administrative, operational, and mission support to the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) regional leadership and field staff. This role serves as the central point of contact for daily office operations, records management, travel logistics, and personnel tracking. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in supporting senior leadership within a government or military environment.

This is an on-site position.

Active Secret Clearance Required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Office & Mission Support:** Coordinate executive calendars, manage conference rooms, monitor office supply inventory, and oversee general mailboxes and task management tracking.
* **Document & Records Control:** Set up and maintain digital and hard-copy files according to DCSA policy. Properly handle, mark, and destroy classified and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).
* **Correspondence:** Draft, format, and proofread high-quality official letters, memos, reports, and executive presentations.
* **Travel & Fleet Management:** Assist staff with Defense Travel System (DTS) travel orders and vouchers. Coordinate Government Owned Vehicle (GOV) logs, dispatch, maintenance, and data entry.
* **Personnel & HR Logistics:** Support civilian employee onboarding/offboarding, track recruitment event milestones, sort resumes, and maintain training records.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree plus 2 years of related experience, OR 8 years of related experience.
* **Security Clearance:** Must have an active SECRET clearance.
* **Communication:** Exceptional oral and written English communication skills.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) to build data tracking tools and reports.
* **Licensing:** Valid driver's license with the ability to safely operate government or rental vehicles (requires GSA Defensive Driver training upon hire).

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to prioritize multiple time-sensitive deadlines simultaneously.
* Sound judgment when handling sensitive personnel and national security information.
* Strong professional presence when interacting with senior military or agency executives.
* Familiarity with federal tracking systems (DTS, inventory tools, task management trackers).

**Other**: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 10%); ability to work in a dynamic, mission-critical environment.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

All employees are responsible for their own safety, as well as that of others in the workplace. To help us maintain a safe workplace, everyone must be safety-conscious at all times. This position is performed in a typical office environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. The safe use of TAPE equipment, as well as safe practices while on TAPE property is essential.

**DISABILITY SPECIFICATIONS:**

TAPE will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Nakupuna Companies is seeking a senior-level Executive Assistant / Senior Program Analyst to join our team providing professional services to the senior leadership of Deputy Portfolio Acquisition Executive - Shipyard Operations (DPAE-SO), formally NAVSEA 04 (Industrial Operations). This individual will work with a team in support of operations under NAVSEA 04 (SEA 04)/DPAE-SO.

Responsibilities:

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this position. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

* Assist in maintaining and updating DPAE-SO Instructions, following the Department of the Navy (DON) Correspondence Manual, that are under the purview of DPAE-SO.
* Prepare reports and briefings for Senior Management in support of DPAE-SO staff.
* Coordinate, schedule and participate in meetings, forums and other activities/events to include drafting agendas, sending meeting invites, recording meeting minutes and actions.

* Collect, compile, input, and analyze information and generate reports for complex administrative projects requiring technical analysis and input from various segments of the organization.
* Provide program management, financial and administrative support to DPAE-SO’s Front Office. Manage action item tracking database and reports.
* Attend Administrative Officer and Corporate Operations conferences and working groups, teams and meetings.

* Package military and civilian awards; create, format, revise, route, and deliver.

* Coordination of travel arrangements includes preparing foreign travel requests and Anti- Terrorism/Force Protection (AT/FP) Plans. Review travel orders and vouchers for accuracy prior to approval.
* Coordinate conference room support; duties include operating audio/visual equipment, providing technical assistance and Video Teleconferencing (VTC) for DPAE-SO for classified and unclassified meetings.
* Prepare visit request documentation for all Government employees to include utilizing Defense Information System for Security (DISS).
* With the appropriate technical oversight of DPAE-SO officials, draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), annually review and update as appropriate.
* Organize material, perform data analytics, and completes writing assignments according to set standards regarding, clarity, conciseness, style, and terminology.
* Review and edit material prepared by other writers and recommend revisions or changes in scope, format, and content. Assist/lead with preparing briefing material for leadership.
* Review, format and route correspondence for signature.
* Input new action items in appropriate tracking system & mark complete the reviewed items via Program Office letters.
* Locate/retrieve/reproduce and distribute documents.
* Update tracking systems with information from weekly correspondence update meetings.
* Coordinates with department heads to obtain a thorough understanding of the correspondence products and requirements.
* Assign and track action items on a daily basis using email and official web-based applications such as DPAE-SO’s integrated development environment (IDE), e.g., DPAE-SO’s SharePoint site.
* Review action item responses for proper content and format, and to ensure that necessary approvals are obtained.
* Transmit daily and weekly reminder emails to personnel (and their supervisors) with assigned actions specifically highlighting overdue and imminent action items.
* Produce quarterly metrics related to action item status, maintain a filing system of incoming and outgoing action items, and updating the filing system weekly.
* Arrange, coordinate, and support DPAE-SO Office of the Admiral/Executive Director, Chief of Staff, and Chief Financial Officer sponsored meetings.
* Provide administrative support including maintenance of the Executive Director filing system and calendars, letter and brief sheet preparation, management of supply orders, training certification completion tracking, and briefing preparation.
* Draft, revise, log, and maintain office correspondence. Assist in coordinating DPAE-SO All Hands Meetings
* Provide professional technical and programmatic assistance to support efforts in DPAE-SO Transformation efforts.
* Assist DPAE-SO Transformation Office (NTO) through framing issues, structuring problem statements, optimizing current processes and providing input to develop strategies and implement change management, leveraging subject matter expertise in Acquisition.
* Coordinate engagements with Naval Staff, Systems Commands (SYSCOM), and Program Executive Offices (PEO), interfacing with client leads to i
