jobs.description:
Overview:

Amyx is seeking to hire a Business Data Analyst to support our DLA Team in the Fort Belvoir, VA area. The position will be on-site 2 days per week with the option to telework 3 days per week.

The Business Data Analyst will support business operations through data collection, analysis, reporting, documentation management, and process improvement efforts. The position will leverage Microsoft technologies and emerging AI capabilities to gather, organize, consolidate, and transform data into actionable information products that support DLA leadership, stakeholders, and mission requirements. The analyst will assist with integrating Microsoft collaboration tools with DLA-approved AI resources to improve operational efficiency, automate recurring reporting requirements, and enhance decision-making.

Responsibilities:

* Collect, analyze, organize, and maintain business, operational, and programmatic data from multiple sources.
* Support preparation of user manuals, training materials, installation guides, reports, proposals, and other customer deliverables.
* Edit and maintain functional descriptions, system specifications, reports, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and maintain systems, programming, operations documentation, procedures, and methodologies.
* Maintain and manage current internal documentation libraries and repositories.
* Provide financial and administrative support as required.
* Coordinate special documentation and reporting services to meet customer requirements.
* Develop and support AI-driven data automation solutions that gather, organize, consolidate, and transform data into actionable information products.
* Develop, configure, and manage AI agents or teams of agents to automate data collection, analysis, knowledge management, and reporting processes.
* Integrate Microsoft tools, including SharePoint, Outlook, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 applications, with DLA-approved AI resources and platforms.
* Support the creation of automated recurring and ad hoc information products, including congressional schedules, DLA-related legislative headline summaries, executive reports, dashboards, and leadership briefing materials.
* Analyze business processes and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency through data analytics and AI-enabled automation.

Technology stack:

Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365 Suite, DLA-approved Artificial Intelligence tools and platforms, Data analytics and reporting solutions.

Qualifications:

Minimum Experience:  

* Five (5) years of relevant experience.
* Must possess IT-III security clearance eligibility or have a current National Agency Check with Local Agency Check and Credit Check (NACLC) at the time of proposal submission.
* DoD 8570/8140 Baseline Certification, IAM Level I.

Required Technical Skills  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with Microsoft Word.
* Experience with Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with Microsoft Access.
* Experience with Microsoft Project.
* Experience with Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience preparing, editing, and maintaining technical and business documentation.
* Ability to communicate accurate information to technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Skills/Qualifications:

* Experience developing or supporting AI-enabled business processes and data automation solutions.
* Experience creating, configuring, or managing AI agents and automated workflows for data collection, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience integrating Microsoft 365 applications, including SharePoint and Outlook, with AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience using Power BI to develop dashboards, visualizations, and executive-level reporting products.
* Experience producing recurring and ad hoc information products, executive briefings, legislative summaries, or operational reports.
* Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) programs.
* Knowledge of data governance, knowledge management, and information lifecycle management practices.
* Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement through automation, artificial intelligence, and data analytics.
* Ability to translate large volumes of data into concise, actionable information for leadership decision-making.

Salary RangeL $70,000- $90,000

Benefits include:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans (PPO & HSA options available)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (Health Care & Dependent Care FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Roth
* Qualified Transportation Expense with matching contributions
* Short Term Disability
* Long Term Disability
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
* Basic & Voluntary Life Insurance
* Wellness Program
* PTO
* 11 Holidays
* Professional Development Reimbursement

jobs.description:
**Career Title:** Data Analyst

**Department:** Data Governance

**Salary:** Competitive salary commensurate with experience

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Note:** Union dues are 1.44% of bi-weekly pay

**Career Summary:**

Join the American Nurses Enterprise (ANE) as a **Data Analyst** and help transform data into insights that advance the nursing profession.

In this role, you will collect, analyze, and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform business strategy and strengthen ANE’s credentialing, training, education, membership, and research programs.

Join the American Nurses Enterprise (ANE) and be part of the team building a healthy world through The Power of Nurses™. Our goals are to (1) Elevate the Profession of Nursing Globally

(2) Evolve the Practice of Nursing to Improve Health, Health Care, and Health Equity and (3) Ensure the Professional Success of Nurses. Our core values: Trusted, Inclusive, Innovative and Empowered guide everything we do. We are committed to creating a supportive and dynamic workplace where employees can thrive.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements and generous paid time off. Our modern office spaces are designed to foster collaboration and creativity. The collaborative culture and supportive team environment make ANE a great place to grow your career.

**What You Will Do:**

* Create, maintain, and update an inventory of all data assets from across the enterprise.
* Maintain data catalog in data governance applications.
* Assist in the development of data policies and procedures and the creation of communication materials related to data and governance.
* Work with key department users to identify use cases and business requirements for the development of data and analytics solutions.
* Convert use cases into business, functional and technical requirements for a data and analytics solution.
* Support selection, design and deployment of a cloud-based data and analytics solution.
* Identify data flows between source systems and target.
* Collect and integrate data from multiple sources including CRM systems, learning management systems, surveys, website analytics, etc. into data and analytics solutions.
* Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on data using statistical methods and tools (R, Python, SQL, Excel, etc.)
* Interpret trends and patterns in data sets and visualize findings using charts, graphs, and dashboards.
* Generate regular reports and presentations summarizing analysis results and recommendations for senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Desing, build and maintain enterprise data visualizations.
* Collaborate with Data Architect to develop and implement strategies for data quality, privacy, governance, and system integration.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automations, and optimizations using data.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with technology, product, marketing, and operations teams.
* Develop data visualizations using PowerBI and Tableau based on user requirements.
* Develop data models based on user requirements and technical capabilities
* Support the design and deployment of data governance.
* Prepare materials for data governance council meetings.

**What you bring to the American Nurses Enterprise:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in statistics, computer science, data science, or related quantitative field.

**Related Work Experience**

* Three (3) years or more as a data analyst preferably in a healthcare or education setting.

**Skills**

* Proficiency with coding languages R, Python and SQL for data analysis.
* Proficient with data visualization tools PowerBI and Tableau.
* Detailed understanding of data lifecycle.
* Strong data modeling skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong data quality orientation.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Ability to translate complex data findings into actionable insights.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Healthcare industry experience a plus

**What ANE Offers You:**

Join us and support more than 5 million Registered Nurses in the United States.

Every role within ANE contributes to a healthier world through The Power of Nurses™.

An opportunity to help transform a 130-year-old organization to meet the future needs and demands within Health Care.

Be a role model for embracing and empowering the uniqueness of every employee.

Continuously innovating through creative and strategic initiatives.

Exceptional benefits including but not limited to 401K retirement contributions of up to 7%, generous PTO which includes the week-off between Dec 25 and Jan 1, in addition to Personal Days-off, 11 paid Holidays, excellent health/medical benefits, and much more.

Commitment to your career development and advancement through ANE learning and development programs (internally and externally).

**Work Schedule:**

Hybrid employees must work a minimum of 20% in the office.

**Location:**

ANE Headquarters office located at: 8403 Colesville Road, Suite 500, Silver Spring, MD 20906

jobs.description:
**USAC’s target compensation range for a new hire into this position is $55,000 - $65,000 USD per year. Actual salary may vary depending on job-related factors based on knowledge, skills, and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process. In addition, this position may be eligible for an annual performance bonus. USAC has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, FSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Commuter Benefits and Wellness Programs.**

**Why Work Here?**

Our mission to achieve universal service addresses America’s current critical needs to build out broadband capabilities for telehealth, online learning, and keeping families connected. Join us and help USAC accomplish our mission to bridge the digital divide. Through its administration of the $10 billion Universal Service Fund (USF) programs on behalf of the FCC, USAC works to promote the availability of quality services at just, reasonable and affordable rates and to increase access to advanced telecommunications services throughout the nation. Additional information on USF programs can be found at: https://www.usac.org/about/

**Benefits**

USAC supports our employees well beyond their salary with a system of benefits that rivals the top organizations in the country. Simply put: if you are committed to improving the lives of others, we are committed to improving yours. USAC provides low-premium, top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision insurance in addition to disability and life coverage. Generous 401k contribution, Federal and floating holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time that increases every year. Regular telework schedule and opportunities to take professional development courses and training.

**A Multicultural Team**

We have actively built an organization that doesn’t just celebrate our diversity; we depend on it. The challenges of achieving universal service require creative and unique perspectives. Our accepting and inclusive community will challenge you to grow and learn from others while always recognizing the value of your contribution.

USAC employees are passionate about our mission. Our work contributes to the success of all Americans. We’ve worked together to build a culture that is collaborative, ambitious, outcome-oriented, and feedback-focused.

jobs.title: GSOC Regional Program Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience implementing security resilience programs impacting teams across multiple regions.
* Experience with multidisciplinary program management in an organization.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Ability to identify, build, improve, or optimize relevant business processes.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring.
* Ability to analyse business objectives and strategies by proactively identifying impactful opportunities or gaps in systems and workflows.
* High ethical standards with demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Excellent judgement, discretion and diplomacy skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive incidents and crises, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

The Global Security Operations Center is GSRS’s 24/7 ecosystem for intake, triage, management and escalation of physical security incidents and threats.

As a GSOC Program Manager, you act as the focal point and principal enabler of program delivery at the regional level. This role supports the GSOC Senior Program Manager (SPgM) with the delivery of multidisciplinary projects and programs spanning people, processes and technology. As a critical enabler of the GSOC strategy and vision, the GSOC Program Manager must leverage a broad skill set across multiple complex workstreams while acting as a strategic partner to key stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support complex cross-functional programs of work, leading both discreet projects and the local implementation of global initiatives as directed by the GSOC Senior Program Manager.
* Drive operational excellence across programs through maturing project documentation, standardizing monitoring of key performance indicators, and effective knowledge management.
* Maintain and develop cross-functional partnerships with key GSRS and external stakeholders, acting as regional representatives for GSOC programs.
* Act as a liaison to partners and support the Regional SOC Manager to improve operational delivery through effective change management, communications and stakeholder engagement.
* Contribute to the GSRS mission to protect, sustain and enable Google’s ability to thrive. Cultivate team norms that foster psychological safety and mutual respect.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Child Safety Digital Investigations Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Digital Investigations Team work with social media platforms, governments, and non-profit organisations to help them understand and navigate digital threats. Our highly skilled team work at the cutting edge of digital threat and online harm, helping clients detect and respond. We use innovative technology and have a deep understanding of everything related to social media and online infrastructure. We're not just about the platforms themselves, but also about the behaviours and intent of those who use them for adversarial outcomes, and those they target.

As an analyst working on child safety, you'll identify and investigate threats to children online. These range from grooming and exploitation to the involvement of minors in online harm networks and violent extremism. Your work will help our clients act before harm spreads and has a direct, real-world impact.

### **What you'll be doing**

* Identifying and tracking online threats involving child sexual abuse material (CSAM), grooming and child exploitation.
* Researching the involvement of minors in sadistic online harm networks and nihilistic violent extremism (NVE), including coercion, extortion and the encouragement of self-harm.
* Map and assess the novel TTPs of bad actors, such as use of language, coded terms and methods of evasion.
* Identify emerging risks and subjects of interest ahead of our clients.
* Deploy our in-house technical capability on investigations.
* Produce concise and contextualised threat reporting.
* Supporting client engagement, interaction and presenting intelligence back to clients

### **On day one you will bring**

* Experience in online research, digital investigations, open-source intelligence (OSINT).
* Knowledge and experience of online child safety, ideally with depth in child endangerment, sadistic online harm or youth radicalisation.
* The mindset of an investigative journalist, a curious and persistent investigator.
* The ability to write clear and concise threat assessments.
* A background in research, safeguarding or intelligence role, whether in law enforcement, journalism, NGOs or tech platforms.
* A resilient, discreet approach to sensitive work, as you will be exposed to challenging material and will need to strictly adhere to protocols.

#### **Why join us?**

* Dedicated wellbeing support, through a specialist provider, that includes regular psychological screening and specialist counselling.
* A diverse and challenging workload across multiple complex projects and investigations.
* A collaborative and supportive team at the forefront of this sphere.
* Clients who get what we do and offer us genuine innovation opportunities.
* A meritocratic environment that promotes career progression and development
* Niche training to support niche skill sets.
* Hybrid working which allows you to strike the perfect work-life balance.

#### **Our Benefits**

* When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of employee benefits, including:
* Performance related bonus
* Life Assurance – 4x your annual salary
* £45 Monthly cost of living voucher
* 25 days’ annual leave plus all standard UK public holidays.
* Vitality Healthcare
* Annual eye care support
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Subsidised gym membership
* Winter flu vaccination
* Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at PGI**

As a British company which operates internationally, we draw strength from the diversity of our people. Without our diverse team, we couldn’t do the work we do. We are involved in projects across 80+ geographies, our people speak 25+ languages and come from a variety of backgrounds. By hiring and cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we can uphold values that enable every member of the team to thrive, while delivering novel solutions to novel problems.

**Accessibility at PGI**

Every individual has different requirements, so we are committed to implementing reasonable adjustments to mitigate physical and non-physical barriers in the workplace.

We strive to make the recruitment process as accessible as possible, but if you have any questions or concerns, please get in touch.

***Please note:*** *We are not accepting applications or speculative profiles from any recruitment agencies. If we require additional resource, we will reach out to you.*

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
With 80 million passengers passing through our airport each year, it takes hundreds of systems, platforms and networks to keep our airport running smoothly, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

Join us, and you'll thrive on the buzz of providing the technology, data, cyber and digital capabilities that run all the services you'd expect to see in a city, and more. Tech at Heathrow isn't typical. The scale and non-stop nature of our airport make it truly unique.

Our Data, Digital and Technology team are leading the way in innovations that will make our airport more efficient, resilient and competitive in an increasingly digital marketplace, as well as keeping Heathrow safe and secure.

Every day will test your skills and give you the opportunity to make your mark. We're constantly looking for new ways to help Heathrow transform and grow, responding to the changing needs of passengers, colleagues and partner businesses.

It means the chance to work on a huge variety of inspiring projects and to develop in lots of exciting directions. Our team covers technology, cyber defence, data and digital, offering one-of-a-kind careers you won't find anywhere else.

  

As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use information to improve passenger experience, streamline operations, and support our sustainability goals. You’ll work within a collaborative team closely partnering with Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders and others across the airport to turn complex data into actionable intelligence. Your work will help Heathrow make smarter, faster, and more customer focused decisions every day.

  

* Working directly with Product Owners and business teams to understand their processes and identify opportunities for data driven improvement.
* Analysing Finance and HR data to uncover insights that inform product and process enhancements.
* Working collaboratively across the business to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and supports strategic goals.
* Translating analytical findings into clear recommendations that support Heathrow’s mission to deliver outstanding passenger experiences.
* Ensuring compliance with relevant governance, risk management and regulatory requirements.

  

* Strong understanding of business processes and how data supports decision-making.
* Experience working with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
* Ability to interpret and communicate complex data insights to non-technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and curiosity to explore new data sources.
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

**Ideally you will have**

* Background in data analytics, business intelligence, or product analysis.
* Experience in aviation or large-scale operational environments.

  

There’s something so special about working at the world’s most iconic airport. Its sights. Its sounds. Its constant air of excitement. Heathrow is an amazing backdrop to a career filled with unique opportunities.

Every day, you’ll discover a world full of fresh possibilities and end the day buzzing with stories to tell, as you encounter people from all cultures, nationalities and experiences. A world full of pride for what we do and no end of exciting career prospects to explore.

It brings out the best in all of us. And inspires everyone to deliver on our ambitious plans. Together, we’re working to welcome millions more passengers while ensuring aviation can continue to be a force for good by leading global efforts in sustainability.

Join us on that journey and we'll help you achieve your ambitions too. Supporting you to learn, encouraging you to be yourself, backing you to achieve more than you might ever have imagined. Because there’s no place like Heathrow.

**Our rewards**

We offer competitive salaries and excellent benefits that will support you now and in the future. As well as performance-based annual bonuses and our longer-term Share in Success Bonus plans, we also offer generous annual leave allowances and market-leading pensions. With family friendly policies, access to private health insurance and a wide range of wellbeing tools, we’ll support you to be at your best inside and outside work. And of course, we’ll provide varied learning and development opportunities too. Here you’ll find everything you need for a fulfilling career journey that can take you in exciting directions.

**Working Location**

Our Hybrid working approach offers the opportunity for colleagues in some roles to work from home for an average of two days a week, providing the flexibility to work in an agile way whilst ensuring we deliver for the operational needs of Heathrow . Working arrangements vary from team to team and will be confirmed during the recruitment process. You’ll need to be based in the UK and within a commutable distance to Heathrow.

**Sustainable Travel to work**

Heathrow’s Sustainable Travel Guide sets out easy and sustainable travel options that everyone can access.
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**

As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from all. We believe that diverse talent makes us stronger – not least because we welcome passengers from all corners of the globe, every single day. Heathrow is an accessible place to work. With five diversity networks, we champion inclusivity and celebrate individuality.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Program Manager/Program Executive
jobs.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce is the leading AI CRM, empowering companies to drive customer success through the combination of human expertise and autonomous agents. We are looking for innovators passionate about transforming businesses through AI and leading workforce transformation in the agentic era. Agentforce is the future of AI, and we are looking for experienced professionals to help our customers navigate this next frontier.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, client-facing individual contributor within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. In this role, you will expertly lead multi-workstream transformations, manage strategic accounts, and oversee complex enterprise implementations where precision is paramount and outcomes have direct C-suite visibility.

You will act as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, fully owning the end-to-end program P&L, leading the Salesforce project team, and governing the budget. Sitting at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations, you will help Life Sciences organizations accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations. Success in this role is defined by consistent delivery, proactive risk management, and the ability to build strong customer confidence.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  

* **Drive AI & Agentic Delivery:** Actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize program delivery, reduce manual overhead, and model the productivity gains our Life Sciences customers aim to achieve.
* **Govern Program Strategy:** Create the program strategy, management approach, and governance models. Guide executive and program-level stakeholders to align on clear objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.
* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Serve as the executive-facing delivery contact for the engagement. Manage communications up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, and issue resolution.
* **Elevate Team Performance:** Lead, inspire, and mentor cross-functional Salesforce Professional Services teams, contributing to methodologies that improve service delivery across strategic accounts.
* **Manage End-to-End Delivery:** Oversee full service delivery to meet all contractual commitments. Maintain financial accountability for bid-versus-delivered margins.

jobs.title: Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

  

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst**

**Location: Farnborough (onsite 5 days per week)**

  

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

  

The Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity, and actionability of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle — from procurement through deployment, operation, redeployment, and disposal. This role is the data backbone of the Hardware Asset Management function, providing the trusted information foundation upon which financial, contractual, compliance, and operational decisions are made.

Aligned to ITAM (IT Asset Management) industry standards and frameworks — including ISO 19770, IAITAM best practices, and ITIL 4 IT Asset Management practice — the HAM Data Analyst ensures that hardware asset records are accurate, reconciled, auditable, and continuously improved. The role operates at the intersection of asset management, configuration management, procurement, finance, operations, and compliance.

This is not a passive data entry role. The HAM Data Analyst is expected to proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies between data sources, challenge inaccurate records, and drive the data maturity of the hardware asset estate to a level that supports confident decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Asset Data Management & Quality

* Own and maintain the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of hardware asset records within the ITAM tool, CMDB, and associated asset repositories.
* Perform regular data quality audits across hardware asset records — identifying gaps, duplicates, orphaned records, misclassifications, and stale data.
* Reconcile hardware asset data across multiple sources including ITAM tools, CMDB, procurement systems, financial systems, discovery tools, and physical audit results.
* Develop and maintain data quality KPIs and dashboards to provide visibility of asset data health to stakeholders and leadership.
* Enforce data standards, naming conventions, classification taxonomies, and mandatory field requirements for hardware asset records.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, escalating systemic issues to process owners and data source owners.
* Ensure asset records reflect the current state of the physical estate — not just what was originally procured or deployed.

Hardware Asset Lifecycle Data Tracking

* Maintain accurate records across all stages of the hardware asset lifecycle:

**Lifecycle Stage**

**Data Analyst Responsibility**

Request & Procurement

Validate asset data at point of purchase order and goods receipt; ensure procurement records feed accurately into the asset register

Receipt & Warehousing

Confirm asset receipt records match purchase orders; validate serial numbers, models, and quantities

Deployment & Installation

Ensure deployment records are updated with location, assigned user, CI relationships, and operational status

In-Service / Operational

Maintain current records for location, ownership, status, warranty, support contracts, and configuration changes

Move / Add / Change (MAC)

Track and update records for asset moves, additions, changes, and redeployments

Redeployment & Reuse

Update records when assets are recovered, refurbished, and redeployed — ensuring full chain of custody

Decommission & Disposal

Validate disposal records including data sanitisation evidence, environmental compliance, and certificate of destruction

End of Life / End of Support

Track and report on assets approaching or past vendor end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) dates

Discovery & Reconciliation

* Reconcile hardware asset data between the authoritative asset register and automated discovery tool outputs to identify:
  + **Ghost assets** — assets in the register but not found by discovery (potentially lost, stolen, decommissioned, or misrecorded).
  + **Unmanaged assets** — assets found by discovery but not in the register (potentially unauthorised, shadow IT, or missed intake).
  + **Data mismatches** — discrepancies in serial numbers, models, locations, ownership, or status between sources.
* Produce regular reconciliation reports and drive resolution of discrepancies with operational and support teams.
* Work with infrastructure, network, and endpoint teams to improve discovery coverage and data accuracy.
* Support physical audit and stock verification activities by providing data extracts, variance analysis, and reconciliation support.

Reporting & Analytics

* Produce regular and ad-hoc hardware asset reports and dashboards covering:
  + Asset inventory by type, location, business unit, status, and lifecycle stage.
  + Data quality metrics (completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency).
  + Warranty and support contract coverage and expiry.
  + End-of-life and end-of-support exposure.
  + Asset utilisation and underutilisation indicators.
  + Cost of ownership and depreciation tracking (in collaboration with finance).
  + Disposal and environmental compliance status.
  + Reconciliation status and variance trends.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to the HAM Manager, ITAM Manager, and senior stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Location: Darrent Valley Hospital, Kent, DA2 8DA**  
**Salary: £62,742 to £69,133 per annum, dependant on experience plus excellent benefits**  
**Schedule: Full time, permanent**

**Ready to impact a better future?**

As a Hard FM Project Manager at Darrent Valley Hospital, you’ll lead the safe, compliant and effective delivery of technically complex Hard FM projects from early identification, survey and scoping through to procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. You’ll play a key role in translating operational requirements and technical asset information into robust project documentation, specifications and delivery plans that support safe, resilient healthcare environments.

Working closely with clinical teams, estates colleagues, technical specialists and contractors, you’ll ensure projects are delivered with a clear audit trail, strong governance and full compliance with CDM2015, statutory duties, Serco requirements and relevant healthcare engineering standards.

**What you’ll do as a Hard FM Project Manager**  
You’ll be entrusted to:

* Manage multiple Hard FM projects and small programmes, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timescales, quality standards and governance requirements.
* Develop clear service user briefs, feasibility reports, business cases, project initiation documents and approval papers that support informed decision-making.
* Interpret mechanical, electrical and water systems information, including surveys, asset condition data, technical reports, drawings, compliance records and specialist recommendations.
* Build detailed technical scopes, specifications, schedules of work and tender documentation that accurately define the required outcome, standards, constraints and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure all projects are planned and delivered in accordance with CDM2015 legislation, including appropriate consideration of client duties, designer and contractor responsibilities, pre-construction information, construction phase plans, RAMS and health and safety files.
* Maintain robust project documentation, version control, approvals, decisions, change records and audit trails throughout the project lifecycle.
* Co-ordinate architects, consultants, engineers, ICT specialists, Authorised Persons, contractors and other professionals to ensure technical, operational and compliance requirements are met.
* Oversee contractor submissions, qualifications, permits, RAMS, commissioning records and handover information, ensuring safe systems of work and appropriate evidence of compliance.
* Manage stakeholder relationships with clinical and non-clinical colleagues, customer representatives, contractors, suppliers and internal Serco teams.
* Support commissioning, handover, training and post-contract activities, ensuring completed works are accepted by user departments and internal support teams.
* Prepare project reports, cost updates, risk information and programme updates for project boards, programme reviews and governance meetings.
* Work collaboratively with Serco colleagues across Fire, Energy, ICT, Procurement, Health and Safety, Estates and operational teams to resolve issues and maintain project momentum.

**Does this sound like you?**  
You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have:

* Proven experience delivering Hard FM, estates, lifecycle or capital projects in a technically regulated environment, ideally within healthcare, hospitals, PFI/PPP or critical infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of CDM2015 legislation and the ability to apply it practically across project planning, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Experience producing and controlling project documentation, including scopes, specifications, tender packs, approvals, reports, risk registers, change records, handover packs and audit evidence.
* The ability to review, interpret and challenge technical information relating to mechanical systems, water safety and electrical infrastructure, drawing on specialist support where required.
* Confidence in developing detailed technical specifications and scopes of work that are clear, commercially robust and suitable for procurement and contractor delivery.
* Good understanding of statutory and non-statutory compliance requirements relevant to Hard FM services, healthcare estates and safe project delivery.
* Experience managing budgets, programmes, contractors, risks, stakeholders and contract administration activities.
* Strong communication, planning and organisational skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical specialists, operational teams and senior stakeholders.
* Experience using CAFM systems, Microsoft Office tools and project reporting systems to maintain accurate records and support governance.
* A relevant technical, construction, engineering, project management or facilities management qualification, or equivalent experience supported by continued professional development.

**Vetting and checks:**  
A Standard DBS check will be carried out for this position. This includes spent and unspent convictions, cautions, reprimands, and warnings as permitted under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act. An Occupational Health Questionnaire will also be completed so we can ensure you have the necessary support to perform your duties.

The postholder will take full ownership of project delivery from initiation through to go-live, managing project governance, technical dependencies, stakeholder engagement, budgets, resources and risk management. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, suppliers and implementation partners, the role will ensure NEC modules are delivered on time, within scope and aligned to organisational objectives.

The NEC Project Manager will provide leadership across complex system implementation projects, ensuring robust governance, operational readiness and successful business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of NEC system projects and module implementations.
* Manage multiple concurrent NEC workstreams and implementation programmes.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans and delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate NEC module deployment activities from initiation through to go-live.

* Implement and manage project governance frameworks and reporting structures.

* Monitor supplier performance and contractual deliverables against agreed service levels.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation and financial controls.

* Support business change, user adoption and transition to operational support teams.
Drive continuous improvement and lessons learned activities following project completion.

* Significant experience delivering NEC system implementations and projects.
* Proven experience managing multiple NEC modules simultaneously.
* Demonstrable experience leading end-to-end system delivery programmes.
* Strong project management experience within complex organisational environments.

  + Stakeholder Engagement
  + System Integration

* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and best practice.
* Experience maintaining and managing RAIDD logs.
* Experience overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and go-live activities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive project delivery.
* Experience managing budgets, resources and programme reporting.
* Excellent organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to support and improve critical business operations across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, and Data teams. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Salesforce order and merchant data, supporting downstream billing processes, improving operational workflows, and driving scalable business process improvements. The role may also support broader business operations, governance, reporting, and priority initiatives across Visa Direct, as required.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with cross-functional teams to improve sales processes, pricing controls, data quality, and revenue operations. This individual will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and operational teams to ensure accurate order management, efficient processes, and strong alignment across systems. This role offers broad exposure across business operations, governance, reporting, analytics, process improvement, and priority initiatives within Visa Direct.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage Salesforce order maintenance activities, ensuring that client merchant records, sales order items, pricing structures, and related data are accurate and complete for downstream billing and revenue processes.
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Billing, Data, and other operational teams to validate deal structures, pricing accuracy, and system controls.
* Support the Global Visa Direct BPO Head and designated team members with the timely preparation of required materials, coordination of key deliverables, execution of assigned business priorities, follow-through on agreed actions and effective response to time-sensitive business requests. Maintain visibility into decisions, owners, milestones, risks, and dependencies and proactively raise issues that may impact delivery. Provide analytical, operational, reporting, co-ordination, and project support across evolving business priorities as required.

* Monitor sales and marketing data to identify trends, reporting gaps, process breakdowns, and data quality issues that may impact business performance or operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing business processes and partner with management to scope, prioritize, and execute operational improvement projects.
* Create, document, and drive adoption of new business and system processes that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance data integrity.
* Serve as a cross-functional liaison across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, operational teams and other business stakeholders to drive alignment and collaboration.
* Support the development and implementation of scalable controls across business systems to ensure pricing validity, order accuracy, and billing readiness.
* Analyze operational workflows and recommend forward-thinking solutions that improve sales processes, support accurate revenue recognition, and reduce operational risk.
* Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements, assess process impacts, and support change management for new tools, workflows, and system enhancements.
* Prepare insights, reporting, and recommendations for leadership to support business decisions and operational improvements.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement through process simplification, automation, AI-enabled productivity, and reporting modernization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

  

* Previous experience in business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, order management, billing operations, or a related analytical role.
* Hands-on experience working with Salesforce, particularly in order management, account records, sales order items, pricing, or opportunity/order workflows.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI tools, including data analysis, reconciliation, structured reporting, and preparation of leadership-ready materials. A good understanding of sales operations processes, deal structures, pricing validation, and downstream billing or revenue recognition impacts.
* Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support implementation of scalable operational solutions.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Sales, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Billing, Data and other business or operational teams.
* Ability to translate business needs into concise and clear process requirements, controls, actionable recommendations and practical operational workflows.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes. Ability to explain complex business concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

PRIMARY PURPOSE
  
These positions are located at NAS Pt. Mugu, CA and Edwards AFB, CA.
  
CNA is hiring for Associate Research Analysts to join their Advanced Technology Assessment (ATA) Division. Staff at this level will provide research, analytical, and technical support on a range of projects.
  
  
As part of the Department of the Navy’s Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), CNA’s Advanced Technology Assessments (ATA) division provides analysis that evaluates the military utility and efficacy of emerging defense technologies and prototypes, operational test and evaluation of DoD programs of record, and tactics development and resourcing decisions for existing naval aircraft.
  
  
Analyses from ATA help the Navy make data-informed resourcing, training, and modernization decisions for new and existing defense technologies, with a focus on naval aircraft. Our research supports defense innovation programs to ensure operational effectiveness and lethality and to maintain the technological superiority of US military forces. ATA also contributes independent analyses to the testing of new aviation systems and the development of tactics to optimize the effectiveness of existing aircraft.
  
CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
  
Our flexible and engaging work environment encourages iterative and creative collaboration at every stage of the problem solving process. Our employees are committed to helping clients develop effective solutions to better manage their programs through scientific, data-driven approaches. We are looking for creative and innovative individuals to help carry out our mission.
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION AND/OR DUTIES
  
1. Under close supervision, conducts research and analysis that meets CNA’s quality standards on focused, structured questions. Can effectively apply standard, routine, and well-established analytic methodologies. With minimal direction and supervision, routinely produces analysis that is logical and traceable as well as objective and unbiased. Shows some analytic creativity.
  
  
2. Develops rudimentary institutional knowledge of primary clients/sponsors; their culture, organization, and issues.

5. Limited interaction with sponsors/clients and their study POCs under the supervision of an experienced colleague.
  
  
6. Impact largely confined to individual project work.
  
  
7. Demonstrates basic, effective communication skills, both written and oral. Can effectively present work to colleagues and CNA managers.
  
  
8. Works under close supervision on focused, well-structured pieces of projects.
  
  
9. Exhibits a positive attitude in interactions with colleagues and clients/sponsors. Serves as an effective member of project or research team by supporting leadership as needed.
  
  
10. Performs other duties as assigned.
  
JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
**1. Education:** Minimum master’s degree in science, Technology, Engineering, Math (STEM), aeronautical engineering or equivalent experience
  
  
**2. Experience:** Typical minimum requirements Master’s & 0+ years of experience in research and analysis.
  
  
**3. Skills:** Facility with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Access, Powerpoint); Ability to manage databases; Ability to gather and organize information on policies, systems, problems, or procedures; Strong critical thinking and organizational skills; Basic knowledge of research techniques; Ability to plan and organize tasks effectively, both as an individual contributor and as a team member; Basic, effective communication skills.
  
  
**4. Remote/Hybrid Work Eligibility:** This position is not eligible for telecommuting or hybrid work arrangements. Occasional flexible work schedule may be possible at the discretion of the Supervisor.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 14,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager to build and lead our new dedicated Greenfield Construction Team. This role owns new-build EV charging infrastructure projects from raw, undeveloped land through energization and handoff to our Operations & Maintenance team, including site civil work, underground utilities, concrete foundations, electrical service, and charger installation. You will direct a traveling team of skilled trades and subcontractors on projects nationwide. This is a high-visibility leadership position for a seasoned construction professional who has delivered ground-up projects and wants the opportunity to shape a team and a playbook from the start.

**Pre-Construction & Planning:**

* Lead due diligence and pre-construction site walks, reviewing geotechnical reports, survey and topographic data, existing utilities, site access, and drainage.
* Review civil, structural, and electrical plan sets and single-line diagrams with engineering; identify constructability issues and value-engineering opportunities before mobilization.
* Develop baseline and look-ahead schedules, budgets, and staffing and equipment plans that sequence excavation, underground, concrete, backfill, and electrical work.
* Coordinate service applications and make-ready work with serving utilities, including transformer pad, service, and metering requirements, and track utility milestones against the schedule.

**Field Execution:**

* Direct day-to-day activities of the Greenfield Team and subcontractors; lead daily safety huddles and weekly progress meetings.
* Ensure 811 utility locates are requested and maintained before any ground disturbance and that critical utilities are verified by potholing.
* Schedule and coordinate AHJ inspections, special inspections, compaction and concrete testing, and utility inspections; maintain inspection logs.
* Partner with the procurement manager on materials and long-lead equipment (switchgear, transformers, chargers) and coordinate deliveries to remote sites.
* Track budget, labor hours, equipment utilization, and change orders; manage RFIs and submittals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for property owners, developers, and client representatives.
* Lead punch lists, final inspections, and commissioning of electrical systems and chargers.
* Deliver as-built drawings, test reports, warranties, and O&M documentation, and hand off completed sites to GWP's O&M team.
* Mentor team members and cross-train them across trades, supporting their growth toward certifications and leadership roles.
* Review and approve time reporting, expense reports, per diem, and travel logistics for the team.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Sr. Construction Manager.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Minimum 4-5 years of construction experience.
* Proven track record managing site civil, underground utility, concrete, and electrical scopes on the same project.
* Experience coordinating with utilities on new services, service upgrades, and low- and medium-voltage electrical infrastructure.
* Ability to read and interpret civil, grading, structural, and electrical drawings, including single-line diagrams.
* Working knowledge of the NEC (including Article 625 for EV charging systems), OSHA construction standards, and local building codes.
* OSHA 30 certification.
* Proficiency with scheduling and project management software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage client, utility, and AHJ relationships.
* Capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in different locations.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with EV charging, solar, battery storage, or other energy infrastructure projects.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Travel & Schedule:**

* Travel is required up to 75-100% of the time to greenfield project sites across GWP's operating states.
* Assignments may last several weeks at a time; overnight and extended stays are expected.
* Work may follow a rotational schedule with planned time at home between assignments.
* Company-paid lodging, travel, and daily per diem are provided while on assignment.
* Overtime and weekend work may be necessary to meet project deadlines; flexibility with work hours and extended workdays is required.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on experience (DOE), up to $140,000 annually.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off.
* Paid training and reimbursement for approved certifications.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding industry.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity.
* Opportunity to make a significant impact on the transition to sustainable energy solutions.

**Additional Information:**

* Criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen,

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world.

Whether aloft in the skies aboard a fighter jet protecting the skies or an airborne surveillance platform monitoring developments on the ground, Raytheon’s Agile Radar Solutions (ARS) mission area is responsible for providing advanced capabilities for multiple types of tactical aircraft and other platforms. We provide the most advanced systems to navigate in challenging environments, and identify and discriminate friendly and foe objects. Part of Raytheon’s Advanced Products & Solutions (APS) business, APS provides capabilities that enable critical tasks-from target identification, aircraft navigation, and target engagement. With our systems, warfighters know where they are going and what they are going to do when they get there.

The F-15 product line within ARS provides development, production and sustainment for the Japan radar products on the F-15 platform. Working directly with the Japan Air Self Defense Forces (JASDF) and multiple in country business partners and manufactures, the Japan F-15 program is a unique, high profile product area for the Raytheon Company.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Provide coordination and oversight to key ThinKom programs including internal research & development, and customer funded projects. Program management at ThinKom includes typical project management duties such as cost and schedule management, resource management, and providing status to key customer and internal stakeholders. Technical knowledge is also needed for engineering coordination, effective planning, and customer communication. Program Managers will often have more than one project at any given time.

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develops technically sound project plans, schedules, and budgets to meet both customer and internal, technical and contractual requirement.
* Identifies resource needs (this position will typically not have direct reports) from the larger engineering staff pool.
* Manages tasks and resources to the established budget and schedule, developing and implementing corrective action and recovery plans when the project falls behind schedule or runs over budget.
* Chairs frequent meetings, normally at least weekly, with the project team to assign tasks, review status, discuss issues, make decisions and work problem resolutions, minimizing and eliminating barriers to program success.
* Interacts with outside suppliers to help manage requirements, schedule, and cost issues related to specific components and/or services being purchased from the particular supplier.
* Manages the customer relationship through effective and frequent communication as the primary point of contact.
* Creates and presents effective PowerPoint presentations for in-depth design reviews, both internally and for customer milestones.
* Assesses, manages, and communicates project risk.
* Communicates internally with management regarding program status and needs, identifying issues, and recommending solutions.
* Manages and maintains scope changes whether from the customer or internally driven.
* Identifies additional sales and up-scope opportunities based on conversations and interactions with customers.
* Provides inputs to support new business proposals.
* Supports Production Reviews.
* Aids in the transition of a design from engineering to production and assists in mitigation of production issues.
* Supports production customer related issues.
* Other tasks as assigned from time to time.

* BS in Engineering, BS/MS in Management, or equivalent experience.
* 2 years of experience in relevant program management or equivalent.
* Demonstrated skills in organizing and directing people and programs.
* Interpersonal skills to constructively manage interactions and working relationships of engineering personnel.
* Ability to multitask effectively and efficiently.
* Ability to negotiate effectively.
* Technically proficient in computer applications: MS Word, Project, Excel, PowerPoint.

  

**Language Skills:**

* Requires strong interpersonal skills and presentation skills. Is able to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of management and/or customers.

**Reasoning Abilities:**

* Ability to communicate calmly and deliberate manner.

**Additional Skills and Experience Preferred (Not Required)**

* Familiar with engineering drawings, design tools, and Windchill PLM software.

  

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must be eligible to obtain and hold a US DoD Security Clearance in support of US Government contracts/ subcontracts.

  

**Physical Demands:**

**Operations Analyst Principal – Rail Transportation Services**
---------------------------------------------------------------

Under general supervision, the Operations Analyst Principal provides high-level technical, administrative, financial, and operational oversight for OCTA’s Rail Transportation Services. This role leads contract administration, regulatory reporting, performance analytics, and business process improvement initiatives that ensure safe, efficient, and compliant rail operations.

Serving as a technical lead and mentor, this position frequently resolves complex operational challenges and represents Rail Transportation Services to internal and external stakeholders.

**This is an exempt position** in salary grade 205: Min $101,275.20 – Mid $120,307.20 – Max $139,339.20/year. The starting salary will be within this range based on qualifications.

* Serve as technical lead for rail operations analytics and contract strategy
* Develop and maintain electronic reporting databases, dashboards, and diagnostic tools to improve contractor performance
* Design and implement business process improvements across rail operations
* Manage National Transit Database (NTD) reporting and monitor national transit trends
* Compile and analyze data related to budgets, operational performance, and regulatory compliance
* Support annual budget development through cost projections, expenditure tracking, and financial analysis

* Coordinate analytical reporting related to service operations, compliance, and project development

### **What We’re Looking For**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum of seven years of professional administrative or analytical experience in transit project or program analysis
* Strong experience in contract administration and regulatory reporting
* Expertise in performance analytics, database management, and dashboard development
* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex operational challenges
* Experience with federal and state transit reporting requirements (e.g., NTD)
* Strong analytical, organizational, and strategic thinking skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

jobs.title: Solutions Implementation Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Being part of HSBC in France, you’ll help evolve and grow our business within **Global Trade Solutions (GTS)**. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank—and we need talent like you to help us get there.

Are you passionate about **international trade**? Do you have experience in **Structured Trade Finance solutions**? Do you enjoy collaborating with diverse teams across countries and functions? If you answered yes, we want to hear from you.

### 

### **What you will do**

**Global Trade Solutions (GTS)** comprises **4,500+ colleagues across 50+ countries**, supporting suppliers and buyers with export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in **1865**, when we financed commerce between Europe and Asia.

The purpose of this role is to lead the **successful end-to-end implementation of Global Trade Solutions deals**, including onboarding of complex deals across the GTS product suite for clients located across European geographies. You’ll drive delivery from client kick-off through funding, including scoping and **Statement of Work** creation, using proven methodologies to deliver a high-quality client experience while accelerating revenue realisation for the bank.

### 

### **In this role you will**

* Lead **end-to-end implementation** of **Structured Finance** deals and selected **Core Trade** products
* Partner closely with **Sales, Operations, Technology and Services**, providing implementation consultancy to clients
* Manage project delivery and technical onboarding, including **UAT** and **PVT** testing to complete programme set-up successfully
* Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across GTS Frontline/Structuring, Coverage (including senior management), IT, Change Delivery, Service Delivery, and global functions (e.g., Risk, Finance)
* Drive cross-business collaboration to ensure strategy alignment, improve efficiency, and share best practices with appropriate senior escalation
* Project manage multiple deals/programmes concurrently, acting as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
* Develop and execute implementation plans using structured project management methodologies; guide clients on responsibilities and tasks within the plan
* Host and attend regular client meetings to track progress, provide accurate status updates, and escalate risks/issues impacting client experience
* Identify process gaps and improvement opportunities; take ownership of initiatives that improve delivery and client outcomes
* Adapt and prioritise effectively across multiple stakeholders and competing demands, maintaining open and transparent communication with Sales, Product and Coverage

### 

### **You should apply if you have**

* Knowledge of **Core Trade** solutions, with experience in **Supply Chain Finance** and **Receivables Finance**
* Demonstrated **project management** experience, ideally with complex multi-stakeholder deliveries
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Operations, Technology and Client Service, including at senior client level
* Proven ability to support **complex global corporates** and **multi-million-dollar programmes**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-driven approach and consistent delivery on time and to quality
* Understanding of **Working Capital Management** concepts and Open Account/Supply Chain/Receivables propositions and business models
* Confidence working in a cross-functional, matrix organisation across international markets and culturally diverse teams
* Ability to manage (or contribute meaningfully to) discussions on relevant **legal frameworks** for Open Account structures
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* **French and English** language skills (preferred)

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

### **What you`ll get in return**

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits covering usually covering healthcare, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “**Top Employer 2026**” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in several countries in Continental Europe. Not only is HSBC a great place to work, but we also offer the following unique and exciting benefits & opportunities!

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Business Analyst F/H
jobs.description:
**L'entreprise**
----------------

MAGNITUDE est une agence spécialisée en Marketing Opérationnel.

Elle accompagne les plus grandes marques (sport, mode, loisir, tech…) dans leur développement commercial, en mettant l’expérience consommateur au centre des dispositifs en magasin.

Magnitude propose à ses collaborateurs de vivre une aventure humaine aux côtés de professionnels passionnés et enthousiastes.

**Description du poste**
------------------------

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations Force de Vente au sein du pôle Force de Vente, vous apportez soutien analytique expert et opérationnel, aux Directeurs de Programme en charge de nos projets de force de vente, avec des enjeux forts de développement commercial, d'ouverture de nouveaux comptes et de génération de chiffre d'affaires.

Véritable support auprès des Directeurs de Programme, **vous les appuyez au quotidien dans le pilotage de leur activité** : **vous suivez la performance des équipes terrain** **dont vous** **analysez les résultats**, vous identifiez les tendances et opportunités et vous fournissez, aux Directeurs de Programmes, les analyses nécessaires à la construction de leurs recommandations et plans d’actions.

**Appuyer le Directeur de Programme en pensant les outils de pilotage**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Comprendre les enjeux du programme, les objectifs fixés et les attentes du client.

* Définir les KPIs pertinents et penser la structure des dashboards.

* Traduire les besoins métiers auprès de l'équipe Data et suivre la construction et l'évolution des outils Power BI.

* Faire évoluer les indicateurs et outils en fonction des besoins du programme et des attentes clients identifiées.

**Suivre et Analyser la performance**
-------------------------------------

* Suivre et analyser les résultats et performances des équipes terrain (par région, commercial, produit, point de vente).

* Identifier les écarts, les tendances, les opportunités et les leviers d'amélioration.

* Réaliser les analyses nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité, auprès du Directeur de programme et faire émerger de l’analyse de la donnée, des recommandations concrètes et quantifiées

**Construire les reportings et les restituer**
----------------------------------------------

* Produire les reportings réguliers (hebdomadaires, mensuels, bilans périodiques) à destination des Managers Régionaux, du Directeur de Programme et du client.

* Mettre en évidence les principaux enseignements et adapter la restitution à chaque interlocuteur.

* Être force de proposition auprès du client pour faire évoluer le contenu et la qualité des reportings.

**Faire vivre les outils et garantir la fiabilité de la donnée**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* S’assurer de la bonne collecte des données nécessaires au pilotage du programme, tout en veillant à la cohérence de l’ensemble de la chaîne data jusqu’à sa restitution

* Assurer le rôle de key user : former les collaborateurs aux outils de suivi et de collecte, être référent(e) sur les procédures et accompagner les utilisateurs en cas d'anomalie.

* Piloter les contrôles de qualité, de cohérence et d'exhaustivité des informations remontées du terrain, et superviser le collaborateur junior en charge de ces contrôles.

* Participer à l'amélioration continue des process et à la veille concurrentielle et marché.

De formation supérieure (école de commerce, marketing ou analyse de données), vous justifiez d'une **expérience consolidée en tant que Business Analyst**, en **analyse de données et pilotage de la performance,** idéalement précédée d'une première expérience commerciale (terrain, développement commercial, gestion de comptes) ou de chef de projet / pilotage de programme.

Vous avez une culture du terrain et **une forte sensibilité business** : vous savez aller au-delà des chiffres, identifier les enseignements clés et les transformer en recommandations d’actions concrètes pour les équipes.

Vous maîtrisez **Excel à un niveau avancé** et avez une bonne maîtrise de **Power BI** pour lire, comprendre et contrôler les rapports et indicateurs existants. Vous savez notamment vérifier la cohérence des résultats, comprendre les règles de calcul et challenger les constructions auprès de l’équipe Data.

Vous comprenez les grands **principes des flux de données**, notamment les fichiers FTP et les API, afin de dialoguer efficacement avec l’équipe Data et de contribuer au suivi des sujets. Une expérience avec des outils d’intelligence artificielle comme Claude est un plus.

Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon sens relationnel, vous aimez travailler en transverse avec les équipes terrain et projet tout comme auprès des équipes clients. Curieux(se) et force de proposition, **vous savez rendre des informations complexes simples, lisibles et actionnables**.
